disposition: No concrete existing cache invalidation defect found in reviewed carrier fields; no application change proposed.

findings.observation: Each snapshot rebuilds lifecycle, ownership, body/pose/velocity, physics and geometry readiness, geometry revision/mass/rectangles and payload_digest. Only seven packed immutable carrier arrays are reused.

Every admitted set_cell payload, role or replacement-identity mutation increments material_revision; changed material/role or explicit identity replacement increments incarnation in the same operation. Identity/revision exhaustion refuses before ordinary writes.
set_due only mutates next_due_tick. It does not change any cached field. payload_digest includes incarnation/birth/due scheduling and is recomputed outside the carrier cache.

Fragment schedule copying changes the fresh child only within exclusive prepare_fragment before its first snapshot. The child has a newly assigned id/generation. Retired/empty slots are omitted; any slot reuse gets a new full handle.

Partial-commit quarantine clears undebited carrier payloads and advances material/topology revision when representable. An artificially exhausted revision remains quarantined; it cannot supply an accepted ordinary publication.
Standalone reset allocates a new monotonically checked session. configure/attach refuse replacing an existing coordinator in one adapter.
Ordinary World replacement unrefs the prior shard adapter, discarding its cache; a fresh attachment allocates a new CyberObjectShardLab. No stale cache crosses World replacement.
RGBA uses the fixed material palette and Wood state_b only; no native tick, scheduling deadline, camera or pose enters cached color generation.

limits: This is an independent source audit, not a new cache or a full-snapshot material-only cache proposal.
No new runtime assertion or performance claim follows from this audit alone.
